name_reason: Already compliant: fd2_ prefix, domain/descriptor 'slide_panel_step_top_small' matches the sibling family (fd2_slide_panel_step_left_main/_right_main/_bottom_main/_bottom_small). 'top' = enters from top edge, 'small' = narrow panel (0x66 wide) vs 'main' = wide panel (0xAA). No address residue; numeric tokens are absent. Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Render one frame of the Party Status Overview top narrow panel sliding in from above, copying a clipped horizontal strip from the composed source buffer into the large game-state framebuffer.
logic_summary: row_count=0x11, src_y=0x13 initial. frame_idx<3 returns (top strip not drawn until main panel arrives). frame_idx>=8: settled, dst_y=0x13. frames 3..7: y_shift=(4-(frame_idx-3))*6, dst_y=0x13-y_shift descending 6 rows/frame; if dst_y<0 the top edge is clipped (src_y=0x13-dst_y, row_count+=dst_y, dst_y=0). Then copy row_count rows, each 0x66 bytes wide at x-offset 0x6D, src stride 0x140 (320), from src_buffer into data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr via memmove.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Linear pointer/offset to the composed source image buffer (full 320-wide frame); the top-panel strip is read from src_y*320+0x6D. Named src_buffer in src C definition.
params.reason: Live Ghidra param is generic param_1; should be src_buffer to match its use as the composed source frame buffer and the sibling slide_panel_step functions' first param. (Stage 2 apply.)

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Animation frame index (0..0xB); gates skip/slide/settle phases. Named frame_idx in src C definition.
params.reason: Live Ghidra param is generic param_2; should be frame_idx to match its role as the slide animation frame counter and the sibling functions' convention. (Stage 2 apply.)

returns.semantics: No return value; writes the strip in place into data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was a single line ('Top narrow panel slide-in from above (0x66-wide, 0x24-high max).') -- accurate but omitted the owning screen/caller, the settle position (y=0x13), and the frame gating. Augmented for precision while keeping the full per-branch algorithm in the Ghidra plate.
notes: Equivalence sanity (not a re-verification): src 'row_count += dst_y' with dst_y=0x13-y_shift equals Ghidra 'row_count = iVar1 + 0x24' with iVar1=-y_shift (both = 0x24 - y_shift); src_y=0x13-dst_y matches. src is a clean, equivalent rewrite. Two call sites both in fd2_open_party_status_overview_screen (0x1b2b4 intro, 0x1b3b5 outro). data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr counted as read+write because memmove dst is an offset into it (read base, write strip).
